limitations: Bounded nonrandom public UI sample, two sections × ten records. Twenty unique game URLs. DOM order is not official rank.
Cloud browser only; no user computer, hidden API, game interaction, voting, or login. Embedded games may load automatically.
Homepage label includes a US flag aria-label; Hot has no separately observed region label.
Hot page title says This Month while visible definition says last 24 hours; conflict preserved without resolving its time window.
Five first unique details inspected, with Boxity.io recovered by one normal same-public-HTTPS new-tab navigation after a transient error. No replacement details added.
Rating explicitly based on last six months. Vote count accumulation window unspecified; K/M counts approximate. Category/tag numbers are catalog counts, not game usage.
No game-level plays or active-user counts observed. Null is not zero and no prior metrics copied.
Bloxd.io and Mahjongg Solitaire contain conflicting header/body release dates, preserved separately without inventing precision.

Twenty cover source URLs observed. Five local candidates fully decoded and byte size/SHA-256 verified, but response status and Content-Type absent from supported API. All cover paths and successful metadata null; no cover bytes published.
Same-tab simultaneous media downloads were refused; the final download batch timed out and reset the runtime. Unconfirmed outcomes are not counted as successful.
Only five fresh detail-based Chinese summaries generated. Remaining fifteen unavailable because cards supply no gameplay text and details are outside the bounded budget.
